title: 第25章 帝族的真正底蕴第26章 体内豢养神魔
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: 龙雀带着怒火消失得无影无踪。
偌大的青铜门前，只剩下了秦然一人。
他笑了笑，敛去脸上的玩世不恭之色，掸了掸身上灰尘，从地上爬起身。
脑海魂宫当中。
一团火焰正被囚禁在魂宫中央。
火焰正中心，能清晰看见一尊神魔虚影盘坐，火焰散发着极度威严霸道气息。
魂宫四面八方，一道道强横的力量不断侵入到火焰当中。
强行分解、摸索、融合……
秦然嘴角笑容压不住了。
他如今还怀着凝聚大夏龙运的使命，所以一开始就笃定，龙雀不会下重手。
果不其然。
在关键时刻，龙雀收力了。
“按照这个分解速度，估计一会儿从始祖殿中出来，应该就差不多了……”
青铜大门只裂开了个一人通过的缝隙。
秦然不再犹豫，迅速踏足其中。
哗。
踏入青铜大门的一瞬，眼前天旋地转，等缓过神时，已进入到了一方独立小世界。
头顶天穹之上，有璀璨星河流转。
脚踏地面，云雾缭绕。
四面八方，一根根雕琢着云纹的盘龙玉柱，通天彻地。
这方世界，俨然如同一片小型星空……
秦然被这画面惊到了。
他抬手抓了把眼前空气，掌心竟染上了丝丝缕缕的淡金色。
空气中，灵气已经浓郁到凝聚成了颗颗金色粒子，漂浮在空气中，宛若淡金色的岁月尘埃。
他深吸了口气，淡金色粒子钻入鼻腔，修为竟都有了隐隐松动的趋势。
“好家伙，原著里我只用了底蕴深厚四个字形容云族始祖殿，我的想象力还是太匮乏了……”
在他前方，星空中漂浮着数以万计的玉简金册。
这些古籍颜色各异，包裹着绚丽光晕，汇聚在一起，宛若一片流动的天穹书海。
在书海的中央区域，汇聚了大量的金色光团，外面皆有虚幻的小字标注。
天阶低品，揽月摘云手！
天阶中品，云海化龙诀！
天阶中品，九劫云篆！
天阶上品，玄黄镇云劲！
天阶中品，云族擒龙手！
content_en:
The dragon bird disappeared without a trace with anger.
Qin Ran was the only one left in front of the huge bronze door.
He smiled, put away the cynicism on his face, dusted himself off, and got up from the ground.
In the soul palace of the mind.
A ball of flame is being imprisoned in the center of the Soul Palace.
In the center of the flame, one can clearly see the shadow of a god and demon sitting cross-legged. The flame exudes an extremely majestic and domineering aura.
From all directions in the Soul Palace, tyrannical forces continued to invade the flames.
Forced decomposition, exploration, fusion...
Kieran couldn't suppress the smile on his face.
He still has the mission of consolidating the dragon fortune of Great Xia, so he was sure from the beginning that Longque would not make a heavy move.
Sure enough.
At the critical moment, Longque withdrew his strength.
"According to this decomposition speed, it is estimated that we will be able to come out of the Ancestral Palace in a while..."
The bronze door only cracked a gap for one person to pass through.
Qin Ran no longer hesitated and quickly stepped into it.
Wow.
The moment I stepped into the bronze door, my eyes were spinning. When I calmed down, I had entered a small independent world.
Above the sky above, there are bright stars flowing.
The feet touch the ground, and the clouds and mist are lingering.
In all directions, there are coiled dragon jade pillars carved with cloud patterns, reaching to the sky and the earth.
This world is like a small starry sky...
Qin Ran was shocked by this scene.
He raised his hand and grabbed the air in front of him, and his palm was actually dyed with strands of pale gold.
In the air, the spiritual energy was so rich that it condensed into golden particles, floating in the air like pale golden dust of time.
He took a deep breath, and the pale golden particles penetrated into his nasal cavity, and his cultivation was beginning to loosen slightly.
"Good guy, in the original work I only used the words "profound foundation" to describe the Yun Clan's Ancestral Palace. My imagination is still too lacking..."
In front of him, tens of thousands of jade slips and gold books were floating in the starry sky.
These ancient books are of different colors, wrapped in a brilliant halo, and gathered together, like a flowing sea of ​​books in the sky.
In the central area of ​​​​the sea of ​​​​books, a large number of golden light clusters gathered, with illusory small characters on the outside.
A low-quality product from the heavenly realm, grasping the moon and picking clouds with your hands!
Middle-grade Heavenly Rank, the Dragon Transformation Technique of Sea of ​​Clouds!
Middle-grade heavenly grade, Nine Tribulations Cloud Seal Script!
The highest grade in the heavenly realm, Xuanhuang Zhenyun Jin!
Middle-grade heaven-level, Yun Clan's dragon capturer!
